search_term.title: Search term
search_term.description: Fallback single job title, keyword, or role to search for when search_terms is empty.

search_terms.title: Search terms
search_terms.description: Optional list of job titles, keywords, or roles. When provided, these override search_term.

location.title: Location
location.description: Fallback single location when locations is empty.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Optional list of locations. When provided, these override location.

posted_within_hours.title: Posted within last N hours
posted_within_hours.description: Only return jobs posted in the last N hours.

results_wanted_per_board.title: Results wanted per board
results_wanted_per_board.description: Maximum number of jobs to request from each selected board.

max_total_results.title: Maximum total results
max_total_results.description: Maximum number of unique jobs returned after deduplication.

job_boards.title: Job boards
job_boards.description: Select which job boards to scrape. LinkedIn is the default stable board for Apify tests. Indeed remains available but can be unavailable or blocked by upstream access.

enable_ai_scoring.title: Enable Laya & JEV Decision Engine
enable_ai_scoring.description: Evaluate fit, offer probability P(Offer), and Job Expected Value (JEV) locally with 0 API keys using the open-source Laya System-1 decision model.

resume_or_key_skills.title: Resume or key skills
resume_or_key_skills.description: Paste your resume or skills summary. Used by Laya to calculate skill matches, missing requirements, and JEV probability. If left blank, Laya evaluates baseline role quality.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (Optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional Claude API key. Not required because Laya runs locally inside the actor for free without any API key.

minimum_ai_score.title: Minimum AI score
minimum_ai_score.description: When AI scoring is enabled, only push jobs with this match score or higher (0-100). Use 0 to disable filtering.

minimum_jev_score.title: Minimum JEV score
minimum_jev_score.description: When AI scoring is enabled, only push jobs with this Job Expected Value (JEV) score or higher (0-100). Use 0 to disable filtering.

indeed_country.title: Indeed country
indeed_country.description: Country used by JobSpy for Indeed searches when Indeed is selected.
